test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who appoints the State Election Commissioner?
solution:
The correct answer is **Governor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The State Election Commissioner** is appointed by the **Governor** of the state.
 
• This appointment is made as per the provisions of the **Constitution of India**.
 
• The State Election Commissioner is responsible for conducting and overseeing elections at the local level, such as municipal and panchayat elections.
 
• The term of office and conditions of service of the State Election Commissioner are also determined by the **Governor**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 The Governor appoints the State Election Commissioner, as per the Constitution of India.
 
 

 Option 2
 The Speaker does not have the authority to appoint the State Election Commissioner.
 
 

 Option 3
 The Chief Minister does not appoint the State Election Commissioner; this is the responsibility of the Governor.
 
 

 Option 4
 The Advocate General has no role in the appointment of the State Election Commissioner.
